'''2006 Rhode Island State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Rhode Island (2 July 2006). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Rhode Island
* '''Dates:''' 2 July 2006
